about: The Board's B2b-vi-a (to-dos/gc-mode/mockups/board-b2b-vi.md): the ring's kernel (stageProgress), How the stage is going's (stageHealth), what changed under a quote (gcStale), thousands and plansReach, lifted to src/lib/gc word for word with no screen. One line differs by hand, E3': stale.ts reads main's lineReach through reachOf(project), over the main-only GcProject.index; the spike keeps gcStale.ts and gcProgress.ts as its own. Of the tests the tool keeps, only the 13 that reach this lift stay; the rest (16 on main already, 11 that reach nothing here) are dropped by title, as the schedule's 9c dropped its 21: stageHealth.test.ts's 8, and one each in progress.log (says which working day this week has no log, on the ring card), progress.punch (reads how a trade stands, on Closeout and on the ring card), progress.submittals (holds the schedule lines it covers until approved, and the ring card says what waits on us), progress.stale (lists the jobs being built whose schedule nobody walked this week) and progress.changes (a trade's request is a Needs you line of its own and a line on the job's ring). Run: node to-dos/gc-mode/scripts/lift-extract.cjs to-dos/gc-mode/scripts/board-b2b-vi.lift.json <outDir>
